title: Supercritical Site Percolation on Regular Graphs
summary: We consider site (vertex) percolation on $d$-regular graphs, for both constant-degree and growing-degree cases. We give sufficient, and relatively tight, conditions for the emergence of the ``Erdős-Rényi component phenomenon" in the supercritical regime $p=\frac{1+ε}{d-1}$: namely, the appearance of a unique giant component of order $n/d$ in the percolated subgraph, with all other components being of size $O(\log n)$.
